verdict.rationale: Undermind's deep review produces a ranked paper list with a written synthesis (docs-4, docs-32), and it creates and edits Markdown reports whose citations link back to sources (docs-6, docs-12). Users can iterate on reports and generate custom tables (docs-38, docs-39), and shared workspaces support collaboration (docs-42). Hands-on users confirm ranked, annotated outputs (comm-8, comm-16). missing for 10: explicit documentation of sectioned report structure, export or share formats for stakeholders outside the workspace (e.g., PDF or link sharing), and independent corroboration of the report and table output quality.
